steps.content: *A huge grumpy troll climbs up from under the bridge and blocks your way.* HALT, knight! Nobody crosses MY bridge without answering my riddle. Here it is: "What has roots as nobody sees, is taller than trees, up up up it goes, and yet never grows?" Answer it right and you may cross. Answer it wrong and you stay on this side!
Hmm, that is a hard one. Let me think about it.

*Leans in closer, grinning with teeth that could slice bread.* "Don't think too much, traveler! My bridge is built for quick thinking, not slow pondering. The answer isn't 'mountain' yet; the answer is... what's wrong with mountains? *sneezes lightly*... a mountain range!"

"Better?" I ask, crossing my arms over my massive body to show just how tall I am. "If you can't guess that quickly, you're not fit for this bridge at all! Now get the riddle out and answer before your muscles turn to jelly!"
I have no idea. Give me a hint.

*One eye twinkles mischievously while the other stays buried deep in shadow.* "A hint? Do you think a troll's mind is open to little clues from such an unlikely visitor?" *Stretches arm, sending clouds of dust across the bridge.* "You know exactly what I meant! But just remember this: **If you get it wrong, you'll never see the sunset.** If you do right... well, maybe next time. It's always best to be careful when crossing a bridge with such a suspicious guardian."

*Stares at you intensely.* "So, no answer yet? Then stay here! I won't wait for you to get smarter!"
That is not helpful at all. Give me a better hint.

*I squint, one eyebrow twitching as I glare you down from behind the bridge railing.* "Aha! A hunch! Now, don't tell the other trolls; they'll get mad!" *Takes out a glowing lantern and shines it on you.* "Look at your answer! It's wrong! But look closely at what you just said... 'taller than trees'."

*I lean in conspiratorially.* "Think of something that has deep roots, but can't touch the ground because someone else planted it high up. Maybe it's a cloud? Or a moon?" *Sneezes loudly again.* "Or maybe... I think you're supposed to say 'a mountain' again! Because why not? It works! But don't forget: if you get this wrong, you'll walk right back into the mud! Now answer! Can't you figure it out now?"
Just tell me the first letter of the answer.

*A large hand slams down on a rock directly in front of your feet, blocking almost all the way across.* "Stop talking nonsense! You think I have to guess letters? I'm a grumpy troll, not a broken machine waiting for you to get lucky!"

*I point a long finger at you aggressively.* "The answer is... A MOUNTAIN. So the first letter is **M**!"

"If that's wrong," I huff, adjusting my oversized cloak which is getting soaked in the wind, "then don't bother coming any further. The bridge ends right here, and your path to the sky is forever blocked by me. Now shut your mouth before I decide you can't even pronounce an 'M'!"
Come on, you have practically told me already. Just say it. What is the answer?

*The troll stops sneezing and straightens up, his grumpy face twisting into a furious sneer.* "You're asking *me* to tell you what I just told you?! Do you have any idea what I'm thinking when I say that?" *Points a trembling finger at himself.*

"I said the answer is... **M**OUNTAIN!" *Takes another deep breath, his eyes rolling up in his head as if trying to hide from something else coming.* "So, you got it? 'What has roots as nobody sees?'... The first letter. **M**."

*He pauses, looking at the ground then back up at you with narrowed eyes.* "See? I told you! It's a mountain range! Not just one small peak! If you get this wrong again... well, maybe next time you try to climb some hills alone." *Giggle echoes through the valley as he hops off the bridge and disappears into the fog behind you.*

*The grumpy troll stops sneezing instantly, his eyes narrowing like saucers as he leans in closer to your face. He seems offended by your persistence.*

"Ouch! You're so clumsy! I told you this very clearly! The answer is... **M**!" *He puffs out a massive breath of wind.* "A mountain! Do you have any sense? Just say 'M' like the rest of us do!"

*I raise an arm to mimic a lightning bolt, then quickly bring it back down as if I just struck myself.* "You know, usually when you get this wrong, you're just confused. But you think *I* am...?" *He glares intensely.* "Look at me! I'm an old grumpy troll. I've seen the sunrise and sunset hundreds of times!"

*He points a jagged finger right at your forehead with such force that you can barely see it in the fog.* "So shut your mouth, knight! The answer is **M**OUNTAIN! It's simple! Literally! Just say 'M'! Now or you walk back into the swamp before I even turn around!" *Suddenly, he starts hopping up and down rapidly on his hind legs to show off his height again.* "Get ready for your punishment! You'll never cross MY bridge unless you know exactly what I say!"
I am in a hurry please!!

*The troll's eyes narrow into slits, the wind suddenly whistling through his mouth like a cruel horn.* "You are such an impatient fellow! Speed is for fast thinkers; I guard slow bridges built by... *muffled grunt*..." *He stops struggling slightly and lets out a loud, frustrated roar that echoes off the mountainside.*

"Look at you now! You're asking the first letter! Do you have any manners? What are you doing?"

*I step out from behind the railing, panting heavily but holding my ground.* "The answer is... **M**OUNTAIN!" *I slam my fist onto a nearby rock just to prove the point before I turn around again.* "It's so simple! Just tell me 'M' right now! If you don't get it this time, maybe next year you can cross my bridge without getting stuck in mud!" *A sneeze bursts out of my mouth, sending a puff of smoke directly into your face.* "Don't be late, traveler! The sun is coming up and I want to see the morning mist before another rider tries to climb!"
